name: basic_isp_top
pixel_format: unsigned 8/10-bit, CH=1 gray or CH=3 packed {R,G,B} MSB->LSB
image_size: static WIDTH x HEIGHT parameters (window foundation is fixed-geometry); cfg img fields must match
pipeline: blc (unsigned subtract, clamp 0) -> wb_gain (UQ4.8, RNE, saturate) -> dpc (3x3 REPLICATE window, |center-med8|>thr -> med8, per-channel) -> gamma (32-segment PWL LUT, sel 0/1/2)
dpc_rule: med8 = floor((s3+s4)/2) of 8 sorted neighbours, Batcher-8 network; <=3 defective neighbours corrected exactly; >=4 may pollute median (documented bound); thr=MPX disables
gamma_tables: generated rtl/gamma_table.vh via models/reference.py emit_gamma_vh(); sel 1 = x^(1/2.2), sel 2 = x^2.2; measured max |err| vs rounded real curve: enc 15/60 LSB (8/10b) at black toe, dec 2 LSB
awb: isp_awb_stats: post-BLC per-channel frame sums + awb_new/awb_frame; gray_world_gains() host-side estimator (model only, no in-hardware divide, no closed loop)
configuration: atomic cfg_valid/cfg_ready only while pipeline empty; cfg_img_w/img_h must equal static geometry; gamma_sel>2 rejected; cfg_done/cfg_error pulses; commit broadcast to all stages same edge
throughput: per-stage II=1 registered stages; DPC input accept bursty (capture/replay), sustained rate WIDTH/(WIDTH+2); one output beat per input pixel
remaining: static geometry only; runtime img_w/img_h exist purely as a legality check
Bayer-domain operation out of scope (DPC needs 5x5 same-phase window); CH=1 is gray/single-plane
DPC input accept is bursty (capture/replay window), end-to-end input II is not 1
gray-world AWB estimate is host-side model only; gains applied via external cfg path; no closed loop
>=4-neighbour same-direction defect clusters may be under-corrected (defined bound)
gamma PWL toe error up to 15/60 LSB at 8/10-bit for the encode curve (measured, documented)
routed timing and board qualification pending
